notes_for_human: metacareers.com is a JavaScript single-page application; static fetch tools (curl, WebFetch) only retrieve an unrendered shell with a generic Organization JSON-LD block — no job/program-specific structured data is present in raw HTML. The specific Meta University pathway URL returns 404 both live and in a Dec-2025 archive snapshot, which is itself notable: it suggests the program page (at least at that URL) had already been taken down before this check, though I cannot confirm whether Meta University was discontinued, renamed, merged into a broader program, or just moved to a different URL — all of those are equally consistent with a 404. No verbatim quotes were obtainable for eligibility, sponsorship, pay, deadlines, or cooling-off/reapplication rules from Meta's own site in this pass. To get real answers you would need either a JS-rendering fetch (headless browser) against metacareers.com, or to search metacareers.com's current internal search/navigation manually for the live Meta University and internship FAQ URLs, since the ones tested here are stale. Browser pass 2026-07-29: the current careerprograms/students/ page renders fully and does not mention Meta University at all — combined with the retired pathway URL (404 live and in a Dec-2025 archive), the program has no live public presence on Meta's careers site.
